thread:
Maria C: heads up — Acme Retail is asking for a Private/VPC pod rec for a seasonal +60% q4 traffic ramp. they want a doc with GPU hours and a conservative hw config by EOD.
Samir Patel: can you drop expected rps and avg tokens per request? i can sketch GPU-hour math quick.
Maria C: good call. target steady-state 400 rps, avg 180 tokens per request, burst to 700 rps for 30m windows. inference model ~= 70B decoder, KV cache sized for 2k context. latency SLO 150ms p95.
Samir Patel: rough calc — assume 70B on H100-80GB gives ~0.9 tok/ms per GPU under our optimized runtime for batched throughput. so 180 tokens/request -> ~200ms per request single-threaded; with batching at 100 reqs ~= much better. i'll convert to GPU-hours.
Samir Patel: quick math snippet:
```
requests_per_sec = 400
tokens_per_sec = 400 * 180 = 72000
tokens_per_gpu/sec ~= 900 (approx)
gpus_needed = ceil(72000 / 900) = 80 GPUs (for steady)
headroom + rolling updates -> recommend 88-96 GPUs
``` 
Samir Patel: that's ~80 GPUs * 24h = 1920 GPU-hours/day -> monthly ~57600 GPU-hours (steady). add 10% for bursts + 15% for maintenance = ~74k GPU-hours/month.
Jess L: are we sure about H100 availability for private customers? many customer racks are A100 80GB. perf diff about 20-30% vs H100 for this model unless we use quantization kernels.
Kai: cost and rack constraints: 80x A100 80GB ~ 40U of chassis depending on chassis density. plan for 2x top-of-rack 100Gb switches for redundancy + 25% network headroom. NVLink between cards matters for some split-shard rtfs but not for our single-node serving path.
Jess L: also call out power — typical A100 rack at that density ~60-70kW. datacenter must validate PDUs and cooling. will add checklist.
Maria C: can someone produce a 1-page hw rec + bullet GPU-hour projection and a follow-up doc for ops checklist (power, network, quota)? i'll send to account team after.
Samir Patel: i can draft the 1-pager. proposed configs (pick one):
- Perf tier: 96x H100-80GB (NVL=optional), 2x 100Gbps ToR, 3x management nodes, 10% spare
- Cost-conscious: 96x A100-80GB, add quantization guidance + conservative throughput estimates (expect ~25% more GPUs than H100)
Kai: linking cost calc sheet (internal): https://redwood-internal/acme-private-hw/ops-estimate (view only). it has per-GPU hourly burn, network, and infra overheads.
capacity-bot: estimated provisioning lead time for 96 GPUs in Private mode: 6-8 weeks (sourcing + rack validation). add to customer timeline.
Jess L: also note region constraints — customer prefers FRA region and our partner inventory there currently limited on H100s. Ops should confirm supply within next 48h.
Maria C: perfect. Samir + Kai + Jess — please assemble and drop final JSON/one-pager in this thread by 15:00 UTC. i'll take it to acct team after review. :thumbsup:
